name: astera-webhook-notifier
description: Posts failed Runs, Tasks whose repairs ran out, questions for a person and completed Runs to a webhook.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Where to post: a Slack incoming webhook, a Discord webhook with /slack added, or a URL of your own that takes JSON.

signingSecret.title: Signing secret
signingSecret.description: Optional. When set, each post carries X-Astera-Signature: sha256= and the HMAC-SHA256 of its body under this secret.

onlyProblems.title: Only problems
onlyProblems.description: Post failed Runs, Tasks whose repairs ran out and questions, but not completed Runs.
